name: literary-book-video
title_zh: 黑底衬宋体、旁白压着呼吸声的书籍短视频流水线
tagline_zh: 把一本书剪成三分钟暗调旁白片：克隆声线、衬线字幕、环境底噪、书封叠化全自动。适合读书博主日更。
tagline_en: Turn any book into a quiet 3-min vertical video: cloned voiceover, Songti subs, ambient bed, cover.
desc_en: Create a Chinese vertical literary book-review short video in the established quiet Siddhartha style: slow cloned narration, restrained emotional copy, dark painterly backgrounds, book-cover overlay, Songti subtitles, forced subtitle alignment, ambient noise bed, FFmpeg rendering, and contact-sheet QA. Use when the user asks to make another book video, imitate the existing Siddhartha/One Hundred Y
why_zh: 它把「安静感」做成了可复现的规格：旁白节奏、字幕强制对齐、噪底电平都有硬参数，不是随缘调色。
why_en: It codifies 'quietness' as reproducible specs—voice pacing, forced subtitle alignment, noise-floor levels—not vibes.
limit_zh: 只认中文竖版书评短视频；输入需已有成稿旁白文本和书封图。FFmpeg 渲染，不处理横屏、不生成字幕文案、不负责选书。
limit_en: Chinese vertical book-review shorts only; needs finished narration script + cover art. FFmpeg-based; no horizontal, no copywriting, no book picking.
